content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I’m having trouble accessing the internal dashboard. Can you help me log in?
Of course. Have you already received your welcome email with the dashboard link?
Yes, I have the email. Should I click the link inside?
Yes, please click the link to open the login page. It should prompt you for your company username.
Okay, it’s asking for my username and password now. Is that my work email?
That’s right—enter your work email as the username, along with the temporary password you received.
I entered them, and now it wants me to set a new password.
Go ahead and create a new password. Make sure it’s at least 8 characters and includes a number.
Done! I’m in. Thanks for your help.
